entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah with VeloFit Customer Support. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah. I'm calling about my new VeloBand Pulse. I've had it for about a week and a half, and it's just not working.
I'm very sorry to hear that. To make sure I understand correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or perhaps a preference issue?
It's definitely a technical fault. It turns on, but it won't sync with my phone or the VeloFit app at all. I've tried everything in the manual. I'm pretty sure the unit I received is defective.

I see. It sounds frustrating when a new device won't sync properly. Let me pull up your order. Okay, I see you received it 11 days ago. For the VeloBand Pulse specifically, we have a strict 10-day window for a full refund, mainly because activating the device links the hardware to a user's account.

Oh, just one day over? That's unfortunate. Since it seems to be broken from the start and I'm so close to the cutoff, is there a way to process a return with a small restocking fee? Or perhaps a partial credit?

I understand where you're coming from, but my system won't allow me to process a refund for the Pulse outside that 10-day period. However, since you're describing what sounds like a defective product, this isn't really a return situation—it's a warranty issue. Our Technical Support team is the right department for this. They can confirm the fault and arrange a free replacement for you.

I see. A replacement is okay, but I'm a bit concerned about the quality now. Since I received a broken item, would you be able to offer a discount code for my trouble? I was planning on buying a VeloFit jersey soon.

I appreciate you asking, but I'm not authorized to provide credits for a hardware issue like this. Our policy is to resolve the core problem, which is getting you a perfectly working device. The Tech Support team is empowered to do just that by sending you a brand new unit if they can't fix it over the phone. Shall I go ahead and transfer you to them?
Okay, that seems fair. If a new replacement is the only way to solve this, then let's proceed. Yes, please transfer me.
Excellent. I'll connect you right now. They'll have all your information. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I'm confident they'll get this sorted out for you.
